resources.string: Stick figures living on your home screen

Stick figures that live on your home screen, behind your icons: they walk above the bottom bar, dance, do flips, play sports… Tap one for an animation; tap anywhere else and the nearest one goes there.
Raise the ground until they stand just above your bottom row of icons.
A live wallpaper replaces your wallpaper. To keep yours, pick the same picture here: it stays behind them. It is copied inside the app and sent nowhere.
This device has no live wallpaper picker.
Changes show up at once on the home screen. Unofficial fan project, free and open source: github.com/Minecraft-2048/mascotte-stickman
